[p]Inspect and process parcels and packages in this parcel inspection simulator! Receive and sort deliveries, examine labels for mistakes, and automate to maximise warehouse efficiency. Upgrade and expand your warehouse to build your parcel empire![/p][p][/p][p][img width="900" height="120"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/97402cc8c327066d94954ecfbf8e9d65.avif?t=1765238964[/img][/p][list][*][p]Examine parcel labels for weight, destination, cargo type and more.[/p][/*][*][p]Key-in or scan barcodes, and dissect parcels for contraband.[/p][/*][*][p]Approve or deny parcels against ever-changing criteria.[/p][/*][/list][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/bd9cbb32c9cbce8454ab2534e35e89a0.poster.avif?t=1765238964" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/bd9cbb32c9cbce8454ab2534e35e89a0.webm?t=1765238964" width="616" height="346"][/imgvid][/p][p][/p][p][img width="900" height="120"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/c5ccad471cd7168622165fa44ecbd111.avif?t=1765238964[/img][/p][list][*][p] Automate label inspections using advanced processing and detection machines.[/p][/*][*][p]Increase warehouse throughput using conveyor belts and storage systems.[/p][/*][*][p]Build complex systems to maximise warehouse efficiency.[/p][/*][/list][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/8f4560a95b2bccad544f1c4b7b6da95c.poster.avif?t=1765238964" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/8f4560a95b2bccad544f1c4b7b6da95c.webm?t=1765238964" width="616" height="346"][/imgvid][/p][p][/p][p][img width="900" height="120"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/a7ad39fbe5a6c5d803fb93d5135b590c.avif?t=1765238964[/img][/p][list][*][p]Categorise and store parcels by cargo type and approval status.[/p][/*][*][p]Route parcel exports via the correct cargo type and ensure they ship on a suitable day. [/p][/*][*][p]Design complex storage and extraction systems with loaders and unloaders.[/p][/*][/list][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/4d50262de34554210dc1f69e8db9eed8.poster.avif?t=1765238964" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/4d50262de34554210dc1f69e8db9eed8.webm?t=1765238964" width="616" height="346"][/imgvid][/p][p][/p][p][img width="900" height="120"]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/06f6a52a5f3dd3fc29419baee9bf1a31.avif?t=1765238964[/img][/p][list][*][p]Expand your warehouse to unlock new delivery bays and receive even more parcels. [/p][/*][*][p] Acquire licenses and upgrade your equipment to earn more money per parcel.[/p][/*][*][p] Customise your warehouse, inspection table, conveyor belts, storage racks, and much more!
[/p][/*][/list][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/8a17ba7d77102a923678d092b1d373ea.poster.avif?t=1765238964" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2424010/extras/8a17ba7d77102a923678d092b1d373ea.webm?t=1765238964" width="616" height="346"][/imgvid][/p]
